description: Short real-run smoke for 24_beit (BEiT: masked image modeling with dVAE visual tokens, Bao et al. 2021): pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch each on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. Its probe reads the model pretrain trains (the frozen BEiT backbone's mean-pooled patch tokens), so linear_eval consumes encoder.pt via @encoder -- the standard shape, NOT the EVAL_DOWNLOAD one. The MIM targets come from a dVAE tokenizer: for a real run this is the frozen OpenAI DALL-E encoder (a hash-pinned download named in provenance.json), but the hermetic smoke leaves TOKENIZER_CKPT empty so the adapter builds a RANDOM tokenizer instead -- nothing is downloaded and no submodule is needed (its accuracy is meaningless by design; only the pipeline is exercised). The paper's ViT-Base/16 (img_size 224, embed_dim 768, depth 12, 8192 tokens, token_size 112, num_masking_patches 75) is shrunk to the tiny architecture the method's own test exercises on CPU: img_size 32 / patch_size 16 (a 2x2 = 4 patch grid), token_size 16 (stride 8 -> a 2x2 = 4 token grid matching the patch grid), embed_dim 32, depth 2, num_heads 4, vocab_size 16, mlp_ratio 2.0, num_masking_patches 2 of 4, min_num_patches 1 -- the real architecture, just small. Every model key is set identically in both stages so load_encoder rebuilds the same BEiT trunk; the tokenizer and masking keys are pretrain-only (the linear_eval config rejects them). Only the run-length knobs (epochs/batch_size/num_workers, warmup_epochs 0) and the tiny-arch dims are overridden.
